metadata.model_identity: Exact model/version not independently available in this coding pass.
metadata.prior_exposure: At task start, only delegated instructions were available; no deliberate prior reading of study results or response data in this pass. General model training exposure to these studies cannot be established or ruled out.

protocol_deviation.event: Attempted to retrieve questionnaire appendix using packet p.34 locator; pages instead exposed aggregate T1/T2 item-knowledge results and community-relations summaries. Stopped all report access and notified coordinator.
protocol_deviation.timing: Occurred after original-source review and after reasoning that all seven Northern Ireland primary implications were unknown, but before writing the final JSON records. No timestamped pre-exposure coding artifact exists.
protocol_deviation.use: No outcome percentages used as evidence or rationale; no respondent records or item-by-community results accessed. This pass must not be called blinded.

metadata.relation_rule: Only supports/challenges codes can generate congenial/uncongenial when linked to a measured eligible baseline position. Other implications map to cannot_classify, retained with reason and excluded from primary directional comparisons. Alternative axes are suggestions, not substitutions for the primary axes.
metadata.source_scope: Packet, coding protocol, outcome-free original questionnaires/codebook/briefings; accidental report exposure explicitly declared. No other coder output inspected.
metadata.translation: Danish fielded questionnaire interpreted by this model-assisted coder; English draft used only as contextual aid, not a substitute for fielded item wording.

records.source_limit: Control key inherited from packet; no independent historical control source reviewed. Neutral is a content judgment, not a claim that no respondent could react affectively.

records.rationale: The approximately 10 million answer is smaller than all distractors, but that ordering does not establish a Democratic position or a congenial fact. The briefing frames approximately 11 million both as an enforcement challenge and as a population whose deportation would disrupt communities.
records.evidence_locator: dp_data/data/america-in-one-room-2019/codebooks/a1r_codebook.tab, PK3, lines 3895-3901; dp_data/data/america-in-one-room-2019/briefing-materials/a1r-2019-briefing.pdf, PDF p.40 (printed p.38), undocumented population and competing values.
records.source_limit: No historical party position establishes a directional mapping for the population magnitude. Approximate packet key 10 million differs from the briefing estimate 11 million.
records.alternative_axis: immigration_enforcement: ambiguous; population size can motivate enforcement or objections to mass deportation

records.rationale: Nonparticipation by three states can support an objection about incomplete international cooperation or a case for US leadership. The briefing explicitly presents both global leadership and competitiveness/burden objections. Neither the item nor this context settles which implication dominates Democratic alignment.
records.evidence_locator: dp_data/data/america-in-one-room-2019/codebooks/a1r_codebook.tab, PK4, lines 3902-3908; dp_data/data/america-in-one-room-2019/briefing-materials/a1r-2019-briefing.pdf, PDF p.32 (printed p.30), Paris Agreement discussion.
records.source_limit: The briefing describes signing while the item says part of; historical treaty status and its date sensitivity were not independently verified. Party mapping is unvalidated.
records.alternative_axis: us_paris_participation: ambiguous; incomplete coverage and leadership rationales point in different directions

records.rationale: The correct bundle identifies coverage extensions and protections. Those are reasons to retain ACA protections, but the reviewed text does not establish a historical Democratic-versus-Republican mapping for this particular bundle, and the fact is not a complete comparison of ACA costs and benefits.
records.evidence_locator: dp_data/data/america-in-one-room-2019/codebooks/a1r_codebook.tab, PK5, lines 3909-3915; dp_data/data/america-in-one-room-2019/briefing-materials/a1r-2019-briefing.pdf, PDF p.23 (printed p.21), ACA provisions and critics; p.30 (printed p.28), ACA glossary.
records.source_limit: Policy-specific supportive content is identifiable; party alignment is not validated by the permitted sources.
records.alternative_axis: retain_aca_protections: supports; confirms three protections whose loss is relevant to repeal

records.rationale: The briefing contrasts lower capital-gains rates with wage rates in the argument for equal taxation, but also presents double-taxation and investment objections. Around 20 percent is a policy parameter, not a demonstrated Democratic-aligned implication without a party-position bridge.
records.evidence_locator: dp_data/data/america-in-one-room-2019/codebooks/a1r_codebook.tab, PK6, lines 3916-3922; dp_data/data/america-in-one-room-2019/briefing-materials/a1r-2019-briefing.pdf, PDF p.12 (printed p.10), taxation discussion; p.17 (printed p.15), capital-gains proposal.
records.source_limit: Briefing states 23.4 percent, packet key is around 20 percent; historical tax scope and rate have not been independently adjudicated. No validated party mapping.
records.alternative_axis: tax_capital_gains_as_wages: supports the stated rate-disparity rationale, conditional on retaining the wage-rate comparison

records.rationale: The keyed proposition compares organizational membership breadth. Having more members neither establishes better trade policy nor supports one US party; the briefing distinguishes global WTO rules from regional agreements and separately discusses benefits and costs.
records.evidence_locator: dp_data/data/america-in-one-room-2019/codebooks/a1r_codebook.tab, PK7, lines 3923-3929; dp_data/data/america-in-one-room-2019/briefing-materials/a1r-2019-briefing.pdf, PDF p.49 (printed p.47), trade institutions.
records.source_limit: Neutral applies to the membership comparison. It does not assign all international-trade facts neutrality or establish party consensus.

records.rationale: The correct proposition makes fines for excessive deficits a possible consequence of joining. In the questionnaire context of lost independence and welfare concerns, exposure to a sanction is an adverse constraint on joining. This is a limited cost implication, not a claim that fiscal discipline cannot be valued.
records.evidence_locator: dp_data/data/denmark-euro-2000/questionnaires/arrival-questionnaire-danish.pdf, PDF p.5, Q4; p.4, Q3c/Q3g; dp_data/data/denmark-euro-2000/questionnaires/departure-questionnaire-danish.pdf, PDF p.5, Q4.
records.source_limit: Key inherited from packet; questionnaire verifies wording and context, not an independent legal answer key. Danish wording interpreted by this model-assisted coder; no human translation validation.

records.rationale: The correct negation says Denmark cannot itself determine the interest rate after joining. It directly supports the questionnaire concern that participation reduces Danish independence, an argument against joining on that dimension.
records.evidence_locator: dp_data/data/denmark-euro-2000/questionnaires/arrival-questionnaire-danish.pdf, PDF p.5, Q5; p.4, Q3c; dp_data/data/denmark-euro-2000/questionnaires/departure-questionnaire-danish.pdf, PDF p.5, Q5.
records.source_limit: Key inherited from packet; questionnaire verifies wording and context, not an independent legal answer key. Danish wording interpreted by this model-assisted coder; no human translation validation. No inference is made about the size of effective pre-entry monetary autonomy.

records.rationale: Retained authority to set tax levels limits the claimed loss of Danish independence and the associated threat to the welfare model. Relative to those explicitly administered concerns, the correct proposition supplies a reason in favor of joining.
records.evidence_locator: dp_data/data/denmark-euro-2000/questionnaires/arrival-questionnaire-danish.pdf, PDF p.5, Q6; p.4, Q3c/Q3g; dp_data/data/denmark-euro-2000/questionnaires/departure-questionnaire-danish.pdf, PDF p.5, Q6.
records.source_limit: Key inherited from packet; questionnaire verifies wording and context, not an independent legal answer key. Danish wording interpreted by this model-assisted coder; no human translation validation. Scope is retained tax authority, not proof that fiscal constraints or welfare effects are absent.

records.rationale: The correct year identifies a conditional implementation timetable. No source establishes that 2004, rather than the distractor years, favors joining. It cannot establish which community is favored by the correct percentage.
